Photo 1 shows a hand holding a camouflage wireless game controller in front of a sign displaying PlayStation PS4 and PS5 logos.
Photo 2 shows a hand holding the internal shell and circuit board of a disassembled controller, with a blue controller in the background.
All photos carry a "GAME FIST" watermark.

risks.risk: The controller may not power on, pair, or have working buttons and analog sticks.
risks.proof: Video of the controller pairing with a PlayStation 4 and all inputs responding.

risks.risk: The controller may have been opened and repaired with unknown or non-genuine parts.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the internal board, battery, and any replaced components.
risks.if_unproven: as a used controller with unknown repair history

proof_requests: Video of the camouflage controller connecting to a PlayStation 4 and passing a full button and stick test.
Close-up photo of any model or serial sticker on the controller.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used PlayStation 4 controller and can be priced at its worst case (not working); functionality proof would raise the value.
